verified_facts.text: The resort is on Koh Yao Noi in Phang Nga Bay, 45 minutes from Phuket.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 45 minutes from Phuket, this Six Senses island resort in Thailand is as close to nature’s luxury as you can be.

verified_facts.text: Limestone pinnacles rising from Phang Nga Bay form the backdrop of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The iconic limestone pinnacles rising from the waters of Phang Nga Bay create a surreal backdrop for Six Senses Yao Noi

verified_facts.text: The resort's surroundings recall the Bond movie setting, with limestone pinnacles rising from the bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: You’ve seen the Bond movie, now experience the real thing. The surreal backdrop to your Thailand island resort holiday includes fantastical limestone pinnacles rising from the bay

verified_facts.text: Villas are enveloped in tropical greenery and each has a private swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villas are enveloped in tropical greenery and complete with a private swimming pool for your ultimate Koh Yao Noi hotel hideaway.

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Retreat offers comfort, privacy and space for groups.
verified_facts.excerpt: Room for all of you: comfort, privacy and space at The Ocean Retreat

verified_facts.text: The Hilltop restaurant offers views with every menu.

verified_facts.text: The Living Room serves authentic Thai cuisine by the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax and savor authentic Thai cuisine by the beach at the Living Room

verified_facts.text: Six Senses Spa offers wellness and healing treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in pioneering wellness and healing treatments at Six Senses Spa

verified_facts.text: Children can join the Junior Eco Warrior Program.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grow With Six Senses with the Junior Eco Warrior Program
